notes.title: Update November 12, 2022
notes.content: Fixed a bug that the data of the first scene freezes when the user selects "No", that the data of the first scene is initialized except for the acquisition status of the star of brilliance when the data other than the first scene is created from the beginning, and that the user can rush infinitely during the flight. Changed the button designations.

notes.title: Update November 7, 2022
notes.content: Fixed a problem with the duplication of the star fragment of brilliance in stage 2_1 and the misalignment of the stardust breath when spitting it out while crouching.

notes.title: Update on November 5, 2022
notes.content: Fixed a problem that makes it impossible to progress in some environments, a problem with gamepad placement settings, and a problem that allows 2_1 shining star pieces to be acquired multiple times. Fixed a bug that prevents the game from going out of the stage unexpectedly.
